cases.name: ACK releases the result and later downloads return 410
no ACK: TTL expires the result, 410 inside tombstone, metadata purged later
ACK during an active download waits for the download lease
repeated ACK is idempotent and does not touch other jobs
ACK racing TTL yields exactly one final state and no orphan files
SIGKILL during cleanup: restart finishes the job with no orphan data
worker SIGKILL: lease expires, job retries, stale token cannot submit
two API replicas: any replica can query, download and ACK the same job
device=gpu_required without a GPU worker is an explicit failure, never silent CPU
invalid and adversarial uploads are rejected without crashing
